authorities.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
authorities.mandate: Corporate incorporation, corporate filings, single member company regulation, and director accountability.

authorities.name: Federal Board of Revenue
authorities.mandate: National Tax Number (NTN) registration, Active Taxpayer List (ATL) management, federal sales tax on goods, and withholding tax compliance.

authorities.name: Pakistan Software Export Board
authorities.primary_statute: Income Tax Ordinance 2001 (Section 154A) & PSEB Policy Guidelines
authorities.mandate: Registration of IT & ITeS exporters and freelancers. Eligible registered exporters who realize export proceeds in foreign exchange through formal banking channels may avail concessionary tax treatment under Section 154A, subject to conditions and rates specified in the applicable Finance Act.

authorities.name: Punjab Revenue Authority
authorities.primary_statute: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act 2012
authorities.mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services rendered in Punjab (standard rate 16%, with specific or reduced rates on designated IT/ITeS services as updated in provincial schedules; verify current applicable law and notification with PRA).

authorities.name: Sindh Revenue Board
authorities.primary_statute: Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act 2011
authorities.mandate: Levy and collection of provincial sales tax on services rendered in Sindh (standard rate 13%, with reduced/concessionary rates on IT services as updated in provincial schedules; verify current applicable law and notification with SRB).

key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: September 30 each year (unless formally extended by FBR)
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Delay past statutory deadline leads to exclusion from the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) and may result in higher applicable withholding rates under the Tenth Schedule. FBR allows restoration to ATL upon filing the return and paying the applicable surcharge under Section 182A, with the ATL register updated on a daily basis.

key_compliance_deadlines.event: Annual Income Tax Return (Companies / Pvt Ltd)
key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: December 31 each year (for tax year ending June 30, unless extended)
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Statutory default penalties under Section 182, exclusion from ATL, and potential loss of tax concessions until return is filed and applicable surcharge is paid.

key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: As prescribed by FBR rules / applicable Finance Act (e.g. quarterly, biannual, or monthly depending on taxpayer category; verify current Iris schedule)
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Penalties under Section 182 for non-filing or late submission of withholding statements under Section 165.

key_compliance_deadlines.statutory_deadline: Minimum 6 years from the end of the relevant tax year (Section 174(3))
key_compliance_deadlines.consequence_of_delay: Under Section 174, failure to maintain and produce accounts/records upon notice may trigger default penalties under Section 182, best-judgment assessment by the Commissioner under Section 121, and potential disallowance of unsubstantiated business expense claims during audit.
